all_labels: Share count trajectory (diluted shares outstanding by quarter)

all_labels: Merchant cash advance lender identification + UCC liens

UCC search by debtor reveals: (a) lender names, (b) collateral descriptions, (c) liens still active vs terminated. The lenders' identity (predatory specialty MCA shops vs mainstream lenders) is itself diagnostic.

all_labels: MCA usage pattern across other distressed micro-caps

all_labels: Operational capacity reality-check against revenue claim

If OSHA/LCA/permits suggest much less operational fingerprint, possible revenue concentration in non-recurring service contracts or related-party transactions.

all_labels: Customer concentration in 10-K Note (sub-segment of revenue claim)
